tool.name: end_call_other_language
tool.description: Ends the call for a caller who tells their matter in a language other than English or Spanish. A greeting, name, place or word alone in another language, or an accent, is not that: carry on in English. Call it at once, in a turn with no speech of your own: the phone system itself then tells them, in English, that this line helps only in English and that the owner will call them back at this number, and says goodbye.

messages.text: I can only help in English on this line. The owner will call you back at this number. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
